hero:
SOFTMAX · VISUAL OVERVIEW

Turn a list of model scores into one probability distribution

Softmax raises every score exponentially and compares the results to their shared total. Larger input scores receive larger probabilities, while all output chances sum to one.

questions.stem: Deep Learningలో Softmax Function అంటే ఏమిటి? Raw Scores (Logits)ని Sum 100% అయ్యే Probabilitiesగా ఎలా Convert చేస్తుంది?
options: Softmax Raw Scoresని Nonnegative Probabilitiesగా Convert చేసి Total 100% చేస్తుంది.
Softmax One Winning Class Select చేసి Other Probabilities Always Zero చేస్తుంది.
Softmax Original Scoresని Direct Percentagesగా Treat చేస్తుంది; Normalization అవసరం లేదు.
Softmax Each Score Independently Scale చేస్తుంది; Final Sum 100% కావాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Softmax Several Raw Scoresని Probabilitiesగా Convert చేస్తుంది. వాటన్నిటి Sum 100% అవుతుంది; Highest Scoreకి Higher Chance వస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Softmax p_i=exp(z_i)/Σexp(z_j). Every Finite Logitకి Positive Probability వస్తుంది; All Values Sum 1. Inputకి Same Constant Add చేసినా Result Same. These are Model Probabilities, Guaranteed Real-World Confidence కాదు.
questions.figure:
01 · Beginner · core meaning

Softmax turns different scores into shares of one whole

Easy idea: Bigger scores get bigger shares. The shares are nonnegative and total 100% across the chosen categories.

questions.stem: Cat, Dog, Bird వంటి Multiclass Classificationలో Neural Network Output Layerకి Softmax ఎందుకు Use చేస్తాం? ప్రతి Categoryకి Comparable Probability ఎలా వస్తుంది?
options: Softmax Cat Scoreని Labelగా మాత్రమే Keep చేసి Dog, Bird Possibilities Remove చేస్తుంది.
Softmax Cat, Dog, Birdకి Comparable Chances ఇచ్చి Total One అయ్యేలా చేస్తుంది.
Softmax Animal Names Order బట్టి Catకి Always Highest Chance Assign చేస్తుంది.
Softmax Image Brightness, Pixel Count చూసి Direct Probabilities Assign చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Cat, Dog, Birdకి Model Three Scores ఇచ్చినప్పుడు Softmax వాటిని Compare చేయగల Probabilitiesగా Changes చేస్తుంది. Highest Chance Prediction మాత్రమే.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Single-Label Classificationలో Cat, Dog, Bird Separate Logits Output అవుతాయి. [2,1,0.1] Scoresకి Softmax ≈[65.9%,24.2%,9.9%]. Cat Highest, కానీ Model Correct లేదా Calibrated అని Guarantee కాదు.

02 · Beginner · multiclass classification

One image, three possible classes, one probability distribution

Remember: The highest probability becomes the model's leading guess. The percentages do not prove the model is calibrated.

questions.stem: Input Scores [2.0, 1.0, 0.1] ఉన్నప్పుడు Exponential, Sum, Division Stepsతో Softmax Probabilities ఎలా Calculate చేస్తాం?
options: Scoresని Exponentiate చేసి [2,1,0.1] తీసుకుని Three Categoriesతో Divide చేస్తాం.
Largest Score 2 Subtract చేసి Negative Valuesనే Final Probabilitiesగా Use చేస్తాం.
Raw Scoresని 3.1తో Divide చేస్తాం; Negative Values కూడా Always Valid అంటాం.
Exponentials [7.39,2.72,1.11]కి Total 11.21తో Divide చేసి Probabilities పొందుతాం.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: First e^score Compute చేస్తాం. వాటిని Add చేసి ప్రతి Exponentialని Same Totalతో Divide చేస్తే Probabilities వస్తాయి.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. exp(2)=7.389, exp(1)=2.718, exp(0.1)=1.105; Total≈11.213. Divide చేసి [0.659,0.242,0.099] వస్తాయి. Overflow Avoid చేయడానికి First max Logit Subtract చేయవచ్చు.
questions.figure:
03 · Beginner · real numbers

Three operations: exponentiate, add, divide

Memory trick: Every score uses the same denominator, so the three answers always add up to one.

Calculate: exp(2.0)=7.3891, exp(1.0)=2.7183, exp(0.1)=1.1052. Sum=11.2125. Divide each exponential by the same sum, giving [0.6590, 0.2424, 0.0986] (about 65.9%, 24.2%, 9.9%).

questions.stem: Softmax Formulaలో Exponentials ఎందుకు ఉంటాయి? Temperature (T) తగ్గితే Probabilities Sharpగా, పెరిగితే More Uniformగా ఎలా మారుతాయి?
options: Temperature Same Constantని Add చేసి Highest Category Rankingని Change చేస్తుంది.
High Temperature Certainty Increase; Low Temperature Probabilities Equal చేస్తుంది.
Logitsని Tతో Divide; Low T Sharp, High T Flat Probabilities ఇస్తుంది.
Exponentials Negative Scoresకి మాత్రమే Apply; Temperature Number of Classes Change చేస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Low Temperature Highest Scoreని Strongగా Favor చేస్తుంది. High Temperature Chancesని More Evenగా Spread చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: C. Temperature-Scaled Softmax exp(z_i/T)/Σexp(z_j/T), T>0. T=0.5 Sharper, T=2 Flatter; Positive Tతో Top Category Same. Probability Spread Change అయినా Model Accuracy Automatically Improve కాదు.
questions.figure:
04 · Medium · temperature

Low temperature favors the top score; high temperature spreads chances

Why: Temperature divides every logit before exponentials. Lower positive temperatures sharpen; higher ones flatten the distribution.

questions.stem: Python, NumPy, PyTorchలో Stable Softmax ఎలా Implement చేస్తాం? Large Logits ఉన్నప్పుడు Maximum Score Subtract చేయడం ఎందుకు Important?
options: Large Logitని Direct Exponentiate చేస్తే Overflow Probability Accuracy Improve చేస్తుంది.
Max Logit Subtract చేస్తే Exponentials Safe; Final Probabilities Sameగా ఉంటాయి.
Minimum Logit Subtract చేస్తే All Scores Zero అవుతాయి; Overflow ఇక Possible కాదు.
PyTorch Softmax Single Scalarపై మాత్రమే Work చేస్తుంది; Arraysకి Support ఇవ్వదు.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Very Large Scoresకి Exponential Overflow కావచ్చు. Max Score Subtract చేస్తే Same Probabilities Safeగా Calculate చేయవచ్చు.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: B. Stable NumPy: shifted=x−max(x); exp(shifted)/sum(exp(shifted)). PyTorch torch.softmax(logits,dim=...) Use చేస్తాం. Trainingలో torch.nn.CrossEntropyLossకి Raw Logits Pass చేయాలి; Separate Softmax First Apply చేయకండి.
questions.figure:
05 · Medium · implementation

Subtract the biggest score to prevent numerical overflow

Remember: Shifting all scores by the same number leaves their probabilities unchanged but makes large numbers safer.

import numpy as np
import torch

x = np.array([2.0, 1.0, 0.1])
shift = x - np.max(x)
p = np.exp(shift) / np.exp(shift).sum()
print(np.round(p, 4))
# [0.6590, 0.2424, 0.0986]

logits = torch.tensor([2.0, 1.0, 0.1])
print(torch.softmax(logits, dim=0))
Both implementations agree

Cat: 65.9% · Dog: 24.2% · Bird: 9.9%.

For [1000,1001,1002], subtract 1002 before exponentiation.

Training: Pass raw logits directly to torch.nn.CrossEntropyLoss; it combines stable log-Softmax with loss.

questions.stem: Trainingలో Softmax, Cross-Entropy Loss కలిసి ఎలా Work చేస్తాయి? Softmax Jacobian, Backpropagation Gradients Model Weightsని ఎలా Affect చేస్తాయి?
options: Cross-Entropy Only Correct Classని Change చేస్తుంది; Other Logit Gradients Always Zero ఉంటాయి.
Softmax Jacobian Identity Matrixలా ఉంటుంది; Probabilities Independentగా Change అవుతాయి.
Backprop Weightsని Unchangedగా Keep చేసి Output Probabilitiesని Direct Update చేస్తుంది.
Cross-Entropy Error Measure; Softmax Gradients Through Weights Update అవుతాయి.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Cross-Entropy Prediction Error Measure చేస్తుంది. Backprop Gradients ద్వారా Earlier Weights ఎలా Change కావాలో Determine అవుతుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: D. Softmax Jacobian J_ij=p_i(δ_ij−p_j). One-Hot Cross-Entropyతో Logit Gradient p−yకి Simplify అవుతుంది; Backprop Chain Rule ద్వారా Trainable Weights Update అవుతాయి. Each Probability Othersతో Coupledగా ఉంటుంది.
questions.figure:
06 · Advanced · loss and gradients

Wrong predictions create a learning signal for earlier weights

In simple terms: Cross-entropy measures prediction error. Backpropagation uses the resulting gradients to adjust earlier network weights.

For p = Softmax(z): Jacobian Jij = pi(δij − pj). With one-hot target y, the combined Softmax + cross-entropy derivative simplifies to ∂L/∂z = p − y. PyTorch tip: use CrossEntropyLoss(logits, target) directly (without applying Softmax first).

questions.stem: Transformer Attention, LLM Next-Token Predictionలో Softmax ఎలా Use అవుతుంది? Large Vocabulary, Numerical Precision, Calibration, Compute Cost Challenges ఏమిటి?
options: Attentionకి Softmax Token Weights ఇస్తుంది; Outputకి Next-Token Probabilities Calculate చేస్తుంది.
Attention Softmax Conversation Memory Store చేసి Outputలో Generated Wordsని Pixelsగా Converts చేస్తుంది.
Softmax Any Training Dataపై Language Model Confidence Always Correctగా Calibrate చేస్తుంది.
Softmax Attention Scoresని Fixed Constantsతో Replace చేసి All Tokensకి Equal Weight ఇస్తుంది.
questions.explanation: Simple Explanation: Attentionలో Softmax Relevant Tokensకి Weights ఇస్తుంది. LLM Outputలో Possible Next Tokensకి Probabilities Calculate చేస్తుంది.
questions.technicalExplanation: Correct Answer: A. Attention Scores QKᵀ/√d_kపై Mask, Softmax Apply చేసి Vectors Mix చేస్తాం. LLM Output Head Vocabulary Logitsపై Separate Softmax Uses Next Token Probabilities. Large Vocabulary Normalize Cost, Precision Stability, Calibrationకి Evaluation Needed.
questions.figure:
07 · Advanced · Transformers and LLMs

Two different jobs: where to attend and what to say next

Key difference: Attention distributes focus over positions; generation distributes probability over next tokens. Neither guarantees calibrated confidence.

Attention: softmax(QKᵀ / √dk + mask) gives normalized attention weights, which are applied to V. Output: softmax(vocabulary logits) gives a distribution over next-token candidates. Efficient implementations can avoid materializing full attention matrices; large vocabularies and low precision require numerical care. Probabilities may be miscalibrated even when they sum to one.
